0x546d58.name: CopyRect
0x546d58.reason: Physical USER32 rectangle copy import; cases control copy and synchronous mutations.

equivalent_mutants.reason: Original 0x4d33bb skips the left adjustment at equality. Changing < to <= adds only destination = destination + clipLeft - x when clipLeft equals x; uint32 subtraction is zero, so every existing destination bit (including CopyRect callback mutations) remains unchanged. No service call or subsequent branch differs.

Original 0x4d33f1 skips the top adjustment at equality. The added equality path writes destinationTop + clipTop - y with clipTop equal to y, an identity modulo 2^32 even after callback mutations. No service call or subsequent branch differs.

Original 0x4d342f skips the target-left clamp at x=0. Destination-left was initialized to x after projection and no callback or write to it occurs before this non-world test; writing zero at equality rewrites its existing zero. All geometry, service calls and output bytes are unchanged.

Original 0x4d344d skips the target-top clamp at y=0. Destination-top was initialized to y after projection; preceding left/right clamps touch distinct words and there is no callback on this path. The extra equality store rewrites the existing zero, preserving all geometry, services and output bytes.

Original 0x4d346f skips the actor-left clamp at x=leftClip. Destination-left already equals x, initialized after projection with no intervening callback on this non-world path. The equality store writes the identical uint32 value leftClip; all later geometry, calls and output bytes are unchanged.

limits: CopyRect and case-supplied DirectDraw callbacks are physical service fixtures; no native display or PID election is claimed.

Projection 0x4c96d0 and compressed dispatcher 0x4bffa0 execute unchanged original code on both comparison sides; valid backed eight-bit PID buffers exercise successful callbacks without entering the diagnostic failure path.
notes: Owns only the exact thiscall2/void raw unflipped helper. Legacy game_image retains its dispatcher and loader ownership. Native display joining and raw PID admission remain separate queue prerequisites.
